name: categorize_item
description: Categorize an RFQ item based on similar items and their categories. You must choose from the available categories provided in the prompt, or select 'Other' if none are appropriate.

category.description: The category for the item. Must be selected from the available categories listed in the prompt, or 'Other' if none are appropriate.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score between 0 and 1 for the categorization

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this category was selected based on similar items and available options
